violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not observed on site.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF FOOD PREPARATION. SEND EHS VERIFICATION THAT ADDITIONAL STAFF ARE OR SCHEDULED TO BECOME CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: Observed the exterior of the warming box, the refrigerator, and shelving unit that houses single service utensils with an accumulation of grime. Observed food splatter on the wall next to the refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. MORE FREQUENT AND ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED.
